questions.q: What does Chris Guillebau say quests often arise from?
questions.why: Quests arise from external events that awaken a calling.

questions.q: How does the book suggest handling a big quest?
questions.why: It advises adjusting your life to fit the quest.

questions.q: What example shows a small step toward a big quest?
a: Learning about race cars for 30 minutes
questions.why: The example is spending 30 minutes learning about race cars.

questions.q: What is the main reward of a quest according to the book?
questions.why: The reward is the struggle toward the goal.

questions.q: Which quote did Chris hear that influenced him?
a: Better to be at the bottom of the ladder you want to climb
Top of the ladder is best
questions.why: He heard the quote about being at the bottom of the desired ladder.
